settingsSections.label: Profiles
settingsSections.description: Each profile is its own cookies, logins and timeline. Open one to rename it, give it a mark, keep it out of the sidebar switcher or clear what it has stored.

settingsSections.label: Embeds
settingsSections.description: Embed websites, YouTube videos and X posts with one surfing code block name.

presets.label: Recommended
presets.description: Reading pages, screenshots and background URL fetches are free; navigating, clicking, typing, opening tabs and fetching in a visible tab confirm first.

presets.label: Allow browsing
presets.description: Let the assistant browse autonomously — navigate, click, type, open tabs and fetch URLs without confirming each step.

presets.label: Read-only
presets.description: The assistant can read and screenshot pages and fetch URLs in the background, but never navigate, click, type or open tabs.

restorable.description: True only when deleting this provider at the returned revisions restores the exact bytes from before this save: neither provider.json nor renderer.tsx existed (not even empty) and removing its catalog entry rebuilds the prior catalog.json, or its absence, byte for byte. Callers offer no undo when false.

command.description: Validate and save an embed-provider definition using observed document and catalog revisions. Preserve existing renderer code and reject duplicate languages.

restorable.description: True only when deleting this provider at the returned revisions restores the exact bytes from before this save: neither provider.json nor renderer.tsx existed (not even empty) and removing its catalog entry rebuilds the prior catalog.json, or its absence, byte for byte. Callers offer no undo when false.

command.description: Delete one custom or customized embed provider’s editable definition and renderer files using its observed document and catalog revisions, and remove its catalog entry. The catalog and files return to the exact bytes they had before that provider was created or customized only when that save reported restorable true and nothing changed since. Built-in providers without files are refused.
